content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

Selling Notion templates for crypto represents a significant shift in how digital creators can monetize their work. Unlike conventional payment processors that charge high fees, like Gumroad's 10% on every sale, using crypto payment solutions such as NOWPayments reduces costs to just 0.5%. This means more revenue in your pocket, enabling you to reinvest back into your business or simply enjoy the fruits of your creativity. Understanding this fundamental difference can change the way you view online sales.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, selling Notion templates without Stripe or PayPal involves a decentralized architecture that leverages cloud-based technologies. This includes using platforms like Cloudflare Pages for hosting and Google Apps Script for backend logic. By integrating NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, you streamline the purchasing process. When a customer pays, your system recognizes the transaction instantly, delivering the product without delay. This efficient architecture ensures that you own everything, from the templates to the customer data.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed for digital creators facing barriers to entry in their local markets. If you are an artist in Cameroon or a developer in Ethiopia, you have likely encountered difficulties with conventional payment processors. This infrastructure caters specifically to you, allowing for seamless transactions in cryptocurrencies, which are accessible and often more reliable than traditional banking systems in your region. It empowers you to reach a global audience without the constraints imposed by traditional platforms.
Reduce your fees from 10% to 0.5% by switching to crypto payments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The successful deployment of your digital commerce stack involves several key components. You’ll need Cloudflare Pages for hosting your products, Google Sheets or Supabase for storing order information, and NOWPayments for handling cryptocurrency transactions. Each element integrates smoothly to create a cohesive system where you can manage your digital store effectively. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you gain access to all necessary blueprints and templates, enabling you to build and launch your store quickly.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started selling your Notion templates, follow these steps: First, select your hosting platform and set up your site on Cloudflare Pages. Next, configure your backend logic using Google Apps Script to handle orders. After that, set up Supabase or Google Sheets for data storage. Integrate NOWPayments for processing crypto payments, ensuring you can accept various currencies. Finally, upload your Notion templates, and your store is ready to go live, allowing you to start selling immediately.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using a decentralized commerce stack. By leveraging cloud-based hosting and integrating a crypto payment processor like NOWPayments, you can accept payments in various cryptocurrencies. This setup allows you to retain a larger portion of your earnings and maintain full ownership of your data and products.
Retain full ownership of your data and digital products with a sovereign stack.

If you are looking for solutions to build a digital download store that accepts only crypto, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides everything you need. Explore options like selling ebooks without PayPal, Stripe, or Gumroad, and discover how to effectively sell your Notion templates for USDT or Bitcoin. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

You can use a combination of Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for processing crypto payments. This method allows you to sell your ebook directly to customers without relying on traditional payment platforms.

Using a decentralized commerce stack with NOWPayments allows you to minimize transaction fees to just 0.5%. This significantly reduces the costs associated with selling digital downloads compared to platforms that charge higher fees.

Yes, by deploying your own digital commerce stack, you can sell templates and fonts directly to customers, bypassing the need for services like Gumroad or Payhip, and maintaining full control over your sales and data.
Are there any hidden fees with crypto payments?
With NOWPayments, the only fee is a transparent 0.5% per transaction. This is significantly lower compared to traditional payment processors, allowing you to keep more of your earnings.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for my products?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to choose which ones to accept based on your target audience and market preferences.
